commits.message:
refactor(renderer): every input and output of a turn is plain data that crosses a process (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265) (#744)

* refactor(renderer): subscriptions are a record and a request's wait ends at an instant, so neither depends on its process (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265)

* refactor(renderer): a turn's failure is data the renderer classifies where it was thrown, and a request's outcome is ok or that failure (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265)

* refactor(renderer): the idle close's event carries its span, and its turn asks the clock whether it goes ahead (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265)

* refactor(renderer): a click crosses to its renderer by its request's id, and the host answers whether its client left (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265)

* test(renderer): the renderer's every input and output crosses a process as JSON, checked at compile time (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265)

* fix(renderer): a turn never rejects to its caller, a request's wait crosses as a span, and an idle close confirms its own firing (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265)

- The host's turn is the one place a renderer's rejection, or an output the
  host cannot take, becomes the turn's failure, so a fire-and-forget delivery
  never leaves an unhandled rejection. Its callers take a TurnOutcome; the
  renderer's output adds the subscriptions the host consumes.
- A request's wait crosses as the milliseconds left at delivery, which each
  process counts on its own monotonic clock, so a wall clock stepped mid-wait
  moves nothing.
- An idle close names the firing it was born of, so a record made since can
  only close by its own firing.
- A render's failure is the daemon's whatever was thrown, as its reply says.
- The collector reads only a subscriptions record's own keys, so a session
  named like an inherited member subscribes to nothing.

* fix(renderer): a render's failure is the daemon's on every path it can fail by, through one rule (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265)

* fix(renderer): the host's whole turn, its hold included, ends as a value (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.265)
